# LocalClaw: The Local AI Index

> A maintained, hardware-aware homepage for choosing local language, voice, image, video, 3D, music and vision models.

- Verified snapshot: 2026-08-20
- Local LLM pages: 217 unique routes across 77 families
- Local speech records: 60 across 54 families (49 TTS, 10 ASR, 1 app)
- Local image, video, 3D, music and vision records: 56
- Latest catalogue release month: Aug 18, 2026
- LLM source states: 177 public GGUF repositories, 36 public model cards without a verified GGUF file and 4 gated model cards
- Scope: hosted-only LLMs, 6 exact-repository-unavailable LLM routes, online Edge TTS, API-only OCTAVE 2 and unverified XTTS v3 are excluded from the ranked homepage index

## Ranking Rules

- Community ★ is the raw 1–5 average from signed-in LocalClaw members and is always paired with a vote count.
- Community confidence uses only stars and vote count with a 3.5/5 prior over five votes. EARLY means fewer than five votes.
- LocalClaw /10 is separate: 38% quality + 24% coding + 24% reasoning + 14% speed.
- Audio /10 is separate: 68% quality + 32% speed.
- Community ratings never change or blend into either software score.
- RAM fit compares a model's catalogue minimum with installed RAM; runtime and context overhead can require more memory.
- Artificial Analysis is an independent performance reference for covered models. Its results are not blended into LocalClaw scores and do not prove local compatibility.

## Core Pages

- [The Local Model Index](https://localclaw.io/) — interactive local-only homepage directory
- [LLM catalogue](https://localclaw.io/llm-list) — complete catalogue surface
- [Speech catalogue](https://localclaw.io/tts-list) — 60 local records, two online/API references and one unverified preserved route
- [Image catalogue](https://localclaw.io/image-models) - local generation and editing models
- [Video catalogue](https://localclaw.io/video-models) - local generation and animation models
- [3D catalogue](https://localclaw.io/3d-models) - local mesh and splat models
- [Music catalogue](https://localclaw.io/music-models) - local song and sound models
- [Vision catalogue](https://localclaw.io/vision-models) - local OCR and document models
- [Newest local models](https://localclaw.io/new) — current releases and RSS feed
- [RAM guides](https://localclaw.io/ram/) — recommendations by memory tier
- [Hardware guides](https://localclaw.io/hardware/) — model fit by machine
- [Use-case guides](https://localclaw.io/use-case/) — chat, coding, RAG, reasoning, multilingual work and speed
- [Live community rating aggregates](https://localclaw.io/api/ratings) — current independent star averages and vote counts as JSON
- [Independent open-weight benchmarks](https://artificialanalysis.ai/models/open-source) — third-party performance context; LocalClaw remains the source for local machine fit
- [Full AI-readable model index](https://localclaw.io/llms-full.txt) - all 333 local homepage entries

- [8 GB](https://localclaw.io/ram/8gb)
- [16 GB](https://localclaw.io/ram/16gb)
- [32 GB](https://localclaw.io/ram/32gb)
- [64 GB](https://localclaw.io/ram/64gb)
- [128 GB](https://localclaw.io/ram/128gb)

## Data Notes

The counts and score leaders in this file are generated from the same repository records as the homepage. Community aggregates are intentionally not frozen here because votes change live; the homepage and each model page show the current average and count independently from LocalClaw scores.
